gameDescriptionHtml:
In Harvest Hunt, the Chosen step into the role of the Warden, tasked as sole protector of the cursed village, Luna Nova. Drawn to its dark secrets and mysterious past, players navigate a treacherous environment stalked by an ancient horror. Players delve into the village’s fear-drenched fields, only to find themselves trapped by a malevolent curse.

Wearing the mask forces Wardens to confront the lurking horrors. They must use cunning and strategy to manage tools, avoid fiends, and escape with the harvest — all while evading the relentless Devourer stalking their every step.

Wardens will find themselves in a desperate race against time, using scarce resources to hide and survive. Every choice could mean the difference between uncovering the mysteries of Luna Nova or succumbing to a grim fate. Only to relive it all, night after night.

Prepare to reap the harvest and end the hunt in Luna Nova’s dark, claustrophobic world.

Game Features

  • Solo First-Person Action: Experience the isolation of being Luna Nova’s sole protector.
  • Five Seasons of Survival: Protect the village across five seasons of five nights.
  • Dynamic Gameplay: Harvest Ambrosia, evade the Devourer, or become its prey.
  • Sacrifice to Survive: Survive by trading health for tools and adapting tactics to face each night’s randomized threats.
  • Relentless Pursuit: Every step stalked by the monstrous Devourer.
  • Intense Runs: Each season demands rapid strategic thinking and quick decision making.
